title: Merge Triplets to Form Target Triplet
summary: Merge triplets by taking the maximum at each of the three positions.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–100000 input triplets. Every triplet and target have length three and values in [1,1000].

statement: Merge triplets by taking the maximum at each of the three positions. Decide whether one input triplet or a merge of selected input triplets can equal target.

examples.explanation: The two triplets supply the required first and second coordinates.
The first triplet overshoots, and the second cannot supply 3 in the first position.
The input already contains the target.

constraints: 1–100000 input triplets. Every triplet and target have length three and values in [1,1000].
hints: Conceptual: A coordinate can grow during a merge.
Directional: Ignore any triplet that already exceeds the target anywhere.
Implementation: For the remaining triplets, track whether each target coordinate appears at least once.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
